title: [Extensibility Request] issue 30400: add credit memo line filter event
summary: A new integration event allows extensions to filter purchase credit memo lines before they are selected during prepayment document updates, enabling customization without replacing standard posting logic.
key_points: New event OnUpdatePurchaseDocumentOnBeforeFindSetCrMemoPurchLine fires before credit memo lines are retrieved
Subscribers can apply additional filters to refine the purchase line selection
Event provides access to purchase header and mutable purchase line parameters
Change propagated across all localization layers (APAC, ES, IT, NA, NL, W1)
Addresses extensibility gap in purchase prepayment posting process
quote: Extensions need to apply additional filters before credit memo purchase lines are selected while updating prepayment documents.
